title: Contravariant naturality of the normalized affine Hom comparison
statement: Let Y be a scheme, U an affine open, A=Gamma(Y,U), T the associated-sheaf functor transported along isoSpec, and c the comparison uniquely normalized on global generators [lem-sc-k4-affine-hom-generator-extension]. For A-modules M, Mprime, N and every f:Mprime->M, c(M,N) followed by internalHom(T(f),id) equals T of precomposition by f followed by c(Mprime,N).

source.place: Lemma-spec-sheaves (4)-(5), Hom functoriality and rank-one evaluation.

proof.text: Precompose the desired equation with each global generator h of Hom_A(M,N). Generator normalization and functoriality identify its two sides with the section corresponding to T(f ≫ h). The internal-Hom section correspondence respects composition. Maps from an associated module are jointly detected by their global generators: apply the chart's tilde adjunction and evaluate the adjoint linear maps at every element. This proves the equation for arbitrary modules, including zero modules and the zero ring.

based_on.place: Lemma-spec-sheaves (4)-(5), Hom functoriality and rank-one evaluation.

lean.statement:
theorem affineHomComparison_chart_left {Y : Scheme.{u}} (U : Y.affineOpens)
    :
    ∀ (M M' N : ModuleCat.{u} (Γ(Y, U.1) : Type u)) (f : M' ⟶ M),
        (affineHomComparison U) M N ≫ SheafOfModules.homObjMap (R :=
          U.1.toScheme.toRingedSpace.sheaf)
          ((affineHomComparisonFunctor U).map f) (𝟙 ((affineHomComparisonFunctor U).obj N)) =
        (affineHomComparisonFunctor U).map (ModuleCat.ofHom (Linear.leftComp (Γ(Y, U.1) : Type u)
          N f)) ≫ (affineHomComparison U) M' N
